numberinput.name: numberinput
numberinput.description:
*Syntax:* `<<numberinput variableName defaultValue minimum maximum [poolCost] [autofocus]>>`

This macro shows a number field with decrease and increase buttons. It stores the selected whole number in the specified variable.

When the macro is in `<<numberpool>>`, each change also changes the pool. `poolCost` specifies the cost of one score point.

*Arguments:*

  * `variableName`: The quoted name of a story or temporary variable.
  * `defaultValue`: The initial whole number.
  * `minimum`: The minimum permitted value.
  * `maximum`: The maximum permitted value.
  * `poolCost`: (optional) The pool cost of one point. The default value is `1`.
  * `autofocus`: (optional) Use this keyword to put keyboard focus on the field.

*Usage:*
```
<<numberinput "$player.age" $player.age 13 65>>
```

numberpool.name: numberpool
numberpool.description:
*Syntax:* `<<numberpool poolVariable>> content [<<onchange>> content] <</numberpool>>`

This macro connects its number controls to a shared pool. The first content section shows the controls.

The optional `<<onchange>>` section runs after a control changes the pool value.

*Arguments:*

  * `poolVariable`: The quoted name of a numeric story or temporary variable.

*Usage:*
```
<<numberpool "$points">>
  <<numberinput "$strength" $strength 8 15>>
  <<onchange>>Points: $points
<</numberpool>>
```

onchange.name: onchange
onchange.description:
*Syntax:* `<<onchange>> content`

Use this child tag in `<<numberpool>>`. Its content runs after a number control changes the pool value.

*Usage:*
```
<<numberpool "$points">>
  <<numberinput "$strength" $strength 8 15>>
  <<onchange>>Points: $points
<</numberpool>>
```

numberslider.name: numberslider
numberslider.description:
*Syntax:* `<<numberslider variableName defaultValue minimum maximum step [autofocus]>>`

This macro shows a range slider and its numeric value. It stores the selected number in the specified variable.

When the macro is in `<<numberpool>>`, each change also changes the pool.

*Arguments:*

  * `variableName`: The quoted name of a story or temporary variable.
  * `defaultValue`: The initial number.
  * `minimum`: The minimum permitted value.
  * `maximum`: The maximum permitted value.
  * `step`: The permitted interval between slider values.
  * `autofocus`: (optional) Use this keyword to put keyboard focus on the slider.

*Usage:*
```
<<numberslider "$volume" $volume 0 100 5>>
```
